description: One thing reaches this page from the backend: `Host::publish` emits a named event, and the window's script listens for it. That is the whole surface granted here. The `invoke_handler` commands are this crate's own Rust functions, so they need no capability entry at all — Tauri gates only its core APIs, and this file deliberately names no command: a list of commands here would go stale the moment one is added, and a stale list is worse than none because it reads like an audit. Nothing here lets the page touch the window, the tray, the menu, or the filesystem, and the page never emits an event of its own: it only receives. If a listener is ever removed from JS (`const stop = await listen(...); stop()`), that path calls `core:event:allow-unlisten`, which is why both halves are listed; a page-side `emit` would have to be added here deliberately, and would mean the renderer is no longer the only author of those rows.
